_comment: P0 七条单人动画,对应 art/requirements/animation_manifest.md §2。全部 In-Place(位移由控制器/Timeline 提供),mixamo 骨架,Unity 以 Humanoid 导入后自动重定向到双角色。

items.name: AN_Player_Idle
items.prompt: a person stands still in a relaxed neutral idle pose, breathing gently, slight weight shifts, subtle head movement

items.name: AN_Player_Walk
items.prompt: a person walks forward at a normal cautious pace, ordinary relaxed gait, arms swinging naturally

items.name: AN_Player_WakeUp
items.prompt: a person slumped sitting asleep slowly wakes up, lifts their head, looks around confused, then stands up

items.name: AN_Player_Swing
items.prompt: a person swings a baseball bat with both hands in a strong horizontal strike, winds up then swings hard and follows through

items.name: AN_Player_HitFall
items.prompt: a person is shot in the chest, jerks backward from the impact and collapses falling to the ground

items.name: AN_Killer_Walk
items.prompt: a tall man walks forward slowly with calm heavy menacing steps, upright posture, deliberate unhurried pace

items.name: AN_Killer_AimFire
items.prompt: a man holding a pistol low raises it with one hand, aims steadily at a target, fires one shot with slight recoil, keeps aiming

items.name: AN_Player_Pickup
items.prompt: a person bends down, picks up a small object from the floor with one hand, then stands back up holding it

items.name: AN_Player_Climb
items.prompt: a person steps up onto a knee-high platform in front of them: raises one foot onto the step, pushes their body up with that leg, brings the other foot up beside it, and finishes standing upright on top

items.name: AN_Player_Throw
items.prompt: a person throws an object overhand with one hand, full overarm throwing motion with windup and follow through

items.name: AN_Killer_DodgeSide
items.prompt: a man quickly sidesteps to the left to dodge something thrown at him, leaning away, then recovers to a steady upright stance

items.name: AN_Killer_KickDoor
items.prompt: a man raises his knee and stomps his foot forward at waist height into a door, heavy front push kick, then plants the foot back down

items.name: AN_Killer_Stumble
items.prompt: a man staggers off balance, arms swinging to stabilize, nearly falls, drops toward one knee, then heavily regains his footing

items.name: AN_Killer_Fall
items.prompt: a man trips and falls forward heavily onto the ground, ending lying face down on the floor

items.name: AN_Killer_BlockLight
items.prompt: a standing man raises one forearm in front of his face to shield his eyes from a bright light, recoiling his head and upper body slightly

items.name: AN_Killer_DrawBackupFire
items.prompt: a man reaches his right hand across his chest into his open coat, pulls out a small pistol from an inner holster, extends his arm to aim forward and fires one shot, keeps aiming

items.name: POSE_Player_SitChair
items.prompt: a person sits slumped and motionless in an armchair, leaning back, arms resting on the armrests

items.name: POSE_Player_CrouchHide
items.prompt: a person crouches low and stays very still, hunched down, hiding behind furniture

items.name: POSE_Player_Prone
items.prompt: a person lies flat face down on the floor, prone, arms forward, motionless

items.name: POSE_Player_KneelHandsUp
items.prompt: a person kneels on both knees with both hands raised high in surrender, staying still

items.name: POSE_Player_HoldSmall_R
items.prompt: a person stands still holding a small object in their right hand at waist level, looking down at it

items.name: POSE_Player_HoldBat
items.prompt: a person stands still in a ready stance holding a baseball bat with both hands beside the shoulder

items.name: POSE_Player_CarryLarge
items.prompt: a person stands still carrying a large heavy object with both arms held in front of the chest

items.name: POSE_Player_AimPistol
items.prompt: a person stands still aiming a pistol forward with one arm fully extended, steady aim

items.name: POSE_Killer_LowReady
items.prompt: a man stands still and alert holding a pistol in one hand pointed down at his side, low ready stance

items.name: POSE_Killer_Kneel
items.prompt: a man kneels motionless on one knee, head lowered, one hand resting on the raised knee, recovering

items.name: PAIR_D08_PlayerSide
items.prompt: a person grabbed from behind in a bear hug struggles violently, twists, is pulled and nearly thrown down, then drives a knee backward to break free

items.name: PAIR_D08_KillerSide
items.prompt: a man grabs and holds someone tightly from behind in a bear hug, gets shaken and dragged around, then receives a knee strike and releases

items.name: PAIR_D11_PlayerSide
items.prompt: a person lying face down on the floor has one ankle grabbed from behind and is dragged backward along the floor, kicking and clawing at the ground

items.name: PAIR_D11_KillerSide
items.prompt: a man crouching low grabs an ankle with both hands and drags a heavy weight toward himself, leaning back and pulling hard

items.name: PAIR_D21_PlayerSide
items.prompt: a person on the ground wrestles desperately, rolling side to side, kicking, pushing against someone on top of them, grappling on the floor

items.name: PAIR_D21_KillerSide
items.prompt: a man on the floor grappling on top, wrestling and pinning someone down, struggling to keep control, rolling and shifting weight

items.name: AN_Player_PutDownLarge
items.prompt: a person carrying a large heavy object with both hands lowers it slowly and steadily, sets it gently onto the floor, then releases their grip and stands back up

items.name: AN_Killer_AimEnter
items.prompt: a man holding a pistol at low ready smoothly raises it with one hand into a steady aiming stance, extending the arm toward a target

items.name: AN_Killer_AimHold
items.prompt: a man holds a pistol aimed steadily forward with one arm extended, staying almost perfectly still, only subtle breathing and tiny muzzle adjustments, minimal motion so the pose can freeze

items.name: AN_Killer_Fire
items.prompt: a man aiming a pistol forward fires a single shot, sharp recoil kicks the arm up briefly, then the aim settles back to the original stance

items.name: AN_Killer_SearchLoop
items.prompt: a man stands alert holding a pistol low ready, cautiously scanning: slowly turning his head and upper body left and right to sweep the area, tense but low-alert, could walk at the same time

items.name: AN_Killer_Run
items.prompt: a man runs fast while holding a pistol in one hand at his side, urgent determined sprint, strong strides, arms pumping
